# 0002 — Token naming and three tiers

`2026-11-07` · accepted · Figma: local variables

**Context.** Tokens must round-trip between Figma and code without a renaming table.
**Decision.** Figma path `a/b/c` → token `a-b-c` → CSS `--a-b-c`. Tiers: `_primitives` (raw) → `_config` (brand decisions: `accent`, `support-1`) → semantic (`text-*`, `icon-*`, `surface-*`, `action-*`, `tab-*`, `border-*`).
**Rule.** Components bind only semantic tokens. `tokens.json` mirrors Figma exactly; `tokens.css` is generated by `build-tokens.js`, never edited.
**Where.** `packages/ui/tokens.json`, `build-tokens.js`.
